column1: # ADR-0144 D2/D3: which file is under which lint set, by the fuzz target that
# enters it (the relation is checked, not derived: targets call crate-root
# re-exports). The tier is per (scope, lint family) — a scope whose families
# differ is split over two rows: `deny` = the scope (the file's own inner
# attribute, or the outer attribute on the item) denies that family;
# `ratchet` = its backlog is rows of docs/lint-baseline.tsv;
# a target that enters no decoder says `none: <reason>` in the file column.

column2: none: enters the whole executor through the command registry; its decoders are the rows above
